This is an early testing version of the game. The current map, UI, weapons, mechanics, and overall gameplay are temporary and will be completely redesigned and improved** in future updates.

Inspired by competitive games like CS2, the goal is simple: aim better, move faster, and eliminate your opponents.

🔫 CURRENT FEATURES

• Competitive Sniper PvP
• Fast-paced combat
• CS2-inspired movement mechanics
• Dash & Slide movement
• Round-based gameplay
• Multiple weapon slots
• Experimental mechanics and systems

🎮 CONTROLS

W A S D — Move
SHIFT — Sprint
SPACE — Jump
E — Dash
C — Slide / Crouch
1 — Primary Weapon
2 — Secondary Weapon
3 — Third Weapon
R — Reload
LMB — Shoot
RMB — Aim

⚠️ TEST VERSION
This place is NOT the final version of the game
